behavior.server: Versioned and legacy JSON failures, including direct operator and uncertain-upload rejections, emit a fixed-format diagnostic containing only the response UUID, bounded status, and allowlisted public code; unknown codes become UNCLASSIFIED. No request path, header, rejected value, exception, or private persisted detail is recorded on this line.
behavior.browser: Only canonical lowercase UUIDs from ApiClientError with HTTP 4xx/5xx status are appended to fixed, locally authored error messages in job, run, history, activity, upload, evidence, policy, and session views. Malformed successful responses and post-header stream failures cannot claim a server failure reference.
behavior.assetErrors: JSON asset failures also emit the fixed-format diagnostic; HTML legacy errors are outside this JSON API correlation path.

An intermediate 94-test JVM run passed 93 and failed the existing UploadServerTest shutdown-timeout case at its second stop; two isolated repeats failed, while later isolated and complete 94-test runs passed. The same isolated case passed twice on the unchanged #1372 base. The final 107-test post-fix run again failed only this case (106 passed). The test releases a worker and retries stop without awaiting worker quiescence; stop can report active ownership while that worker is still finishing. This is recorded as an intermittent pre-existing race, not a green full regression.
